episodes.title: DEADLY CULT EXPOSED! Andy Ngo Uncovers the Zizians' HORRIFYING Secrets
episodes.description:
Alex Marlow sits down with investigative journalist Andy Ngo for a chilling exposé of the Zizians, a secretive Silicon Valley cult linked by investigators to multiple deaths, alleged murders, bizarre psychological experiments, and extremist beliefs about artificial intelligence. Ngo reveals shocking details from his investigation, including secret hideouts, alleged sleep-deprivation experiments, the group's mysterious leader Jack LaSota, and disturbing parallels to Charles Manson's murderous cult. 

Plus, Ngo challenges mainstream media coverage of the case and explains why he believes the victims have been denied justice in one of America's most unsettling true-crime investigations.
